title: llm-clinical-coding-ent: code for comparing LLMs, clinicians and clinical coders on inpatient ENT coding
description: Pipeline and analysis code accompanying 'Large Language Models Reach Human-Level Agreement in Coding Otolaryngology Clinical Notes'. Includes the prompting pipeline (extraction, SNOMED CT grounding, ICD-10/OPCS-4 mapping and admission scoping), the agreement and hypothesis tests, the clinician evaluation metrics and the power analysis. No patient data are included.

creators.name: Health Informatics Collaborative Hearing Health Consortium
